title: JSON
explain: The `encoding/json` package turns structs into JSON with `Marshal` and back with `Unmarshal`. Struct tags like `json:"name"` control the key names, and `omitempty` skips empty fields. Only exported fields, the ones with a capital letter, are included.
exercise: Decode a JSON array of users into a slice of structs and print each name.
tip: Unexported (lowercase) fields are silently skipped by `encoding/json`. If a field is missing from the output, check its capitalization.
